title: Check a message shape
summary: WebSockets: Check a message shape. Send {"text":"Hi"} as JSON.
introduction: A parsed object may still be missing a field. This example sends an empty object and gets a clear reply.
learningObjectives: Check a message shape with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Check a message shape

blocks.text: The object has no text string, so the type check chooses Message needed.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Parsing JSON and checking its field types are separate jobs.
